title: [bug] lichen-rpl cargo test broken on main: dao_origin_vectors.rs includes nonexistent dao_origin_signature_upstream.json
description: Pre-existing on main (introduced by 46ea60fcaf 'chore(beads): worker8 sync'): rust/lichen-rpl/tests/dao_origin_vectors.rs:28 include_str!("dao_origin_signature_upstream.json") but no file by that name exists anywhere in-tree (only test/vectors/dao_origin_signature.json). Breaks 'cargo test -p lichen-rpl' compilation entirely (all test targets fail to build). Discovered by beads-worker6 while verifying the rpl_messages.json corpus regen (project-LICHEN-worker6-1p2r.3) via cargo test -p lichen-rpl. Likely fix options: (a) the file was meant to be committed with worker8's dao work — locate/restore it; (b) rename the include to the existing test/vectors/dao_origin_signature.json; (c) if upstream-regen dao corpus is pending lptm (same as project-LICHEN-worker6-1p2r dao child), gate the test. Needs the dao-domain context of worker8's change. NOTE: cargo test on this host needs CARGO_TARGET_DIR=build-worker6-target (rust/.cargo/config.toml points at the Mac /Volumes/Attic path).
